applications.summary: Specialize the locally assembled normalized finite-family same-step inverse theorem at k=r-1.
applications.status: author successor; exact candidate application review pending

source_hypotheses.required: Fixed k>=3 and positive threshold at most one for bounded GI.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Set k=max(s,4)-1>=3; the bounded theorem is an input to the relative theorem.
source_hypotheses.justification: Assembly003 supplies the normalized bounded implication; no boundedness assumption is made on the original prime weight.
source_hypotheses.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

constructed_objects.required: Connected simply connected step-at-most-k nilmanifolds with cocompact lattices, fixed metrics and linear orbits.
constructed_objects.constructed: Use the exact finite family in assembly003 Section1, with the same-step P1 linearization and metric bounds proved in Section6.
constructed_objects.justification: The accepted local assembly concludes the linear formulation, not merely a polynomial orbit on an unspecified higher-step extension.
constructed_objects.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

index_domain_coverage.required: Every interval length and every one-bounded complex function above the threshold.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The target quantifies over all N and f, including finite lengths handled in its base and compactness steps.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Specialization of k and threshold preserves both universal quantifiers.
index_domain_coverage.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

transition_maps.required: The real bounded GI premise in GT Proposition10.1.
transition_maps.constructed: Restrict the complex input to real functions; choose a real or imaginary component of the complex test.
transition_maps.justification: One component retains at least 1/sqrt(2) of the correlation; neither the supremum nor Lipschitz bound increases.
transition_maps.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

consumed_object_identity.required: GI(r-1) in the relative inverse theorem for the same normalized interval norm.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Use the local target at k=r-1 and threshold min(alpha*delta/(4C_*),1/2).
consumed_object_identity.justification: The exact zero-extension ratio and finite family are those in the relative theorem interface.
consumed_object_identity.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

coefficient_conventions.required: Normalized interval Gowers norms and compatible correlation convention.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Use the zero-extension norm divided by the indicator norm in a common sufficiently large cyclic group.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Assembly Section1 states this convention; conjugating a test changes neither its degree nor bounds.
coefficient_conventions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

local_conditions.required: A finite family with smooth metrics fixed before length and orbit parameters.
local_conditions.constructed: Assembly003 fixes the family and constants after k and delta only.
local_conditions.justification: The accepted rational lattice, fixed geometry and same-step construction are linked in its component contracts.
local_conditions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

exceptional_cases.required: Remain in the declared target k>=3 and preserve every low-order input qualification.
exceptional_cases.justification: No direct invocation of the target at k=1 or 2 is needed here; the local proof contains its separately reviewed lower-order induction base.
exceptional_cases.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

downstream_consumption.required: Supply the bounded GI premise to the reusable relative theorem, then the concrete full-majorant bridge.
downstream_consumption.constructed: V14-GAU-GT-RELATIVE-INVERSE consumes this target; the bridge separately constructs f, nu and the norm lower bound.
downstream_consumption.justification: This is a local theorem application. The final GTZ statement and unpublished correction are historical provenance, not substitute premises. Exact candidate binding still requires independent review.
downstream_consumption.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

applications.premise_status: The active bounded inverse supplier is the independently accepted local assembly003, relative to its retained published inputs. applications.summary: Use final GT relative inverse with full pseudorandomness.
applications.status: author successor; exact candidate application review pending

source_hypotheses.required: Retain every premise of GT Proposition10.1, including GI(k) and full pseudorandomness.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Form the conditional implication for any qualifying real f and ν, with the displayed parameter range.
source_hypotheses.justification: This is the reusable implication. The local GI application supplies its bounded premise; the separate bridge supplies the concrete f, nu and norm bound.
source_hypotheses.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

constructed_objects.required: The reusable implication quantifies over a measure on the whole prime cyclic group and a real interval function.
constructed_objects.constructed: Keep f and ν as universally quantified inputs subject to the stated hypotheses.
constructed_objects.justification: Their concrete prime-weight construction belongs to the successor bridge, which directly depends on the full-majorant application.
constructed_objects.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

index_domain_coverage.required: Require all linear forms, shifts and moments in the published pseudorandomness definition.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The implication retains every condition at degree (k+2)2^(k+1); an S-pseudorandom input with larger S is sufficient.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Restriction of the universally quantified conditions gives the required degree. No specific majorant is constructed by this reusable implication.
index_domain_coverage.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

transition_maps.required: Retain the normalized interval norm and the real GI premise.
transition_maps.constructed: Quantify over any threshold δ0 in(0,1] and require the same f to have norm at least δ0.
transition_maps.justification: The successor later substitutes min(αδ/(4C_*),1/2); this reusable implication does not prove that substituted lower bound.
transition_maps.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

consumed_object_identity.required: The output correlation must concern the same universally quantified input f.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Retain f unchanged in the correlation average over[L].
consumed_object_identity.justification: The successor instantiates f with the truncated scaled centered weight and handles its relation to h.
consumed_object_identity.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

coefficient_conventions.required: Use real-valued input and the correct normalized averages.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The input is real; interval averages divide by L and cyclic averages by Q.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The factor Q/L is accounted for in the norm comparison.
coefficient_conventions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

local_conditions.required: Require prime Q and the fixed ambient range.
local_conditions.constructed: Choose prime Q in[C_*L,2C_*L] with C_*≥20 and C_*>2^r.
local_conditions.justification: Both the supplier domain and the chosen norm convention hold.
local_conditions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

exceptional_cases.required: Do not recast a qualitative pseudorandom theorem as a DK finite-tolerance statement.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Verify the whole asymptotic family and apply the conclusion for sufficiently large lengths.
exceptional_cases.justification: No explicit η or uniform convergence rate is claimed.
exceptional_cases.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

downstream_consumption.required: The inverse output must be a fixed finite family, uniformly in L,z,b.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The family depends only on k,C_* and the fixed norm threshold.
downstream_consumption.justification: The fixed-modulus nilsequence input takes the maximum of the finitely many thresholds.
downstream_consumption.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

applications.summary: Construct full prime majorant with fixed factor and explicit cutoff normalization.
applications.status: author successor; exact candidate application review pending

source_hypotheses.required: Preserve the hypotheses and constants of the divisor and Euler-product estimates.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Fix S,T,E,C_* and the explicit χ,cχ,γ before selecting unit residues and the slow cutoff.
source_hypotheses.justification: The CRT error and local ranks are checked directly, so γ does not vary with V.
source_hypotheses.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

constructed_objects.required: Construct one nonnegative measure with normalized mass and pointwise domination.
constructed_objects.constructed: Set tildeν=φ(V)/(VTcχ) times the sum of divisor squares; ν=(1+tildeν)/2 on the interval and1 outside.
constructed_objects.justification: Nonnegativity follows from squares; the full linear-forms calculation gives mass; the prime-point calculation gives α.
constructed_objects.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

index_domain_coverage.required: Cover every S-bounded finite-complexity system, every shift list and every fixed moment.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Use uniform local ranks, finite cyclic partitions, all residue pairs and a separate zero atom.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Affine constants, repeated shifts and every fixed q are included; coverage is not restricted to cubes.
index_domain_coverage.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

transition_maps.required: Transport the fixed modulus factor and the integer estimates to the cyclic group.
transition_maps.constructed: Cancel all small-prime factors, partition by wraparound and sum the lifts u,u−Q,u+Q.
transition_maps.justification: Each partition and normalization is explicit, with a bounded number of pieces.
transition_maps.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

consumed_object_identity.required: The same ν must satisfy domination and both pseudorandomness conditions.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Define ν once before proving its lower bound, linear-forms property and correlation bounds.
consumed_object_identity.justification: The proof never substitutes a different measure between these arguments.
consumed_object_identity.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

coefficient_conventions.required: Retain the exact cχ and φ(V)/V factors.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Divide each square by cχ and use α=γ/(8Tcχ).
coefficient_conventions.justification: The factor cχ^m cancels cχ^(−m); no claim that cχ equals1 is made.
coefficient_conventions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

local_conditions.required: Handle small primes and prime powers in fixed E.
local_conditions.constructed: Eventually all p dividing E lie below z, and each b is a unit modulo V.
local_conditions.justification: Divisor events at p dividing V are empty; outside z, V is invertible and the bounded coefficient minors are nonzero.
local_conditions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

exceptional_cases.required: Do not apply the nonzero-difference formula at repeated shifts.
exceptional_cases.justification: Its contribution to every fixed moment is L^(−1+o(1)); the divisor bound is justified in the proof.
exceptional_cases.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

downstream_consumption.required: Supply the precise complexity and fixed scaling needed by both inverse and von Neumann uses.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Choose S≥(r+1)2^r and at least the von Neumann requirement, with T fixed per application.
downstream_consumption.justification: The same lemma supplies a single weight for inversion and any fixed finite list for the later multilinear estimate.
downstream_consumption.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

applications.summary: Replace DK bridge by full pseudorandom relative inverse and fixed-modulus diagonal.
applications.status: author successor; exact candidate application review pending

source_hypotheses.required: Apply the relative inverse theorem, full majorant lemma and fixed-modulus nilsequence input simultaneously.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Fix the complexity before δ, construct ν, and raise the norm order of the real dominated f.
source_hypotheses.justification: The displayed norm-transfer argument joins the full majorant, the relative theorem with the local GI premise, and the fixed-modulus nilsequence estimate.
source_hypotheses.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

constructed_objects.required: Use the actual centered ray-prime weight from the manuscript.
constructed_objects.constructed: Use h_C,V,b with the same μ_C(b) and factor φ(V)/V, at fixed stage V_z.
constructed_objects.justification: An ordinary centered prime weight is not substituted for the ray-class weight.
constructed_objects.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

index_domain_coverage.required: Cover every relevant class union, residue, required norm order and inverse-family member.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: At each stage take maxima over the finite lists and all unit residues modulo its fixed V.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Uniform majorant estimates also cover a subsequence selected because it violates the norm conclusion.
index_domain_coverage.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

transition_maps.required: Track truncation, scaling, norm raising, metric comparison and the physical scale.
transition_maps.constructed: Use the displayed o(1) truncation error, α, factor1/(2C_*), fixed metric comparison and thresholds N_j.
transition_maps.justification: Each loss is fixed before the size limit or included in an explicit stage threshold.
transition_maps.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

consumed_object_identity.required: Recover small U^s norm for the original h, not only its truncation.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Any fixed δ failure forces positive correlation for α times the truncated h, and hence for h.
consumed_object_identity.justification: The bounded-test truncation error tends to zero and α is fixed and positive.
consumed_object_identity.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

coefficient_conventions.required: Keep normalized interval and finite-group averages distinct.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Use the zero-extension ratio and L/Q≥1/(2C_*).
coefficient_conventions.justification: No equality of the two unnormalized norms or constant-one interval monotonicity is asserted.
coefficient_conventions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

local_conditions.required: The nilsequence input requires a fixed modulus divisible by conductor D.
local_conditions.constructed: Fix V_z at each stage before choosing its size threshold; the additional factor E remains fixed.
local_conditions.justification: No uniform rate in a growing modulus is assumed.
local_conditions.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

exceptional_cases.required: Handle small norm orders, the initial interval and the allowed threshold range.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Set r=max(s,4), truncate below L^(3/5), and cap the inverse threshold at1/2.
exceptional_cases.justification: These choices remain in the supplier ranges and preserve positive fixed constants.
exceptional_cases.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending

downstream_consumption.required: Supply the precise negligible Gowers norm needed by the existing fixed-system replacement and cube bridge.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The fixed-system replacement and normalized Gaussian cube argument retain their mathematical text; exact raw transport is recorded separately.
downstream_consumption.justification: The accepted conditional DK replacement supplies this connection relative to GI. Assembly003 supplies that GI target; the current candidate composition is submitted for independent review.
downstream_consumption.status: author comparison; independent successor review pending
